entities.name: Ancestral Mask
entities.description: An ancient enchantment-bestowing artifact of pottery shards hidden in the tomb of Sia-am-Erh in the Rushwood of Mercadia.

entities.name: Sia-am-Erh
entities.description: Cho-Arrim shaman whose tomb held the mask.

entities.name: Cho-Akhan
entities.description: Cho-Arrim who discovered and wielded the mask to protect her village.

entities.name: Cho-Ran
entities.description: Cho-Akhan's brother, who died of the plague.

entities.name: Rushwood
entities.description: Place in Mercadia where the tomb lay.

events.summary: Cho-Akhan discovers the Ancestral Mask many years after Sia-am-Erh's death.
events.quote: her mask was discovered by the Cho-Arrim Cho-Akhan

events.summary: After plague kills her brother, Cho-Akhan decides to wield the mask against Mercadia City.
events.quote: she decided to wield the Ancestral Mask to protect her village

events.summary: The mask takes control of Cho-Akhan and plunges her into the river, where deceased souls imbue her with power.
events.quote: The Ancestral Mask took control of 'Akhan's body and plummeted her into the river

events.summary: Cho-Akhan and her two mothers prepare for war with Mercadia City.
events.quote: 'Akhan and her two mothers, Cho-Shadi and Cho-Fihad, prepared for war with Mercadia City.

relations.quote: her brother Cho-Ran died from the sickness
prepared for war with Mercadia City
